title: When to Commit and When to Defer: Maturing Markov Decision Processes under Refining Information and Expiring Opportunities
abstract: arXiv:2606.18820v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sequential decisions often become better informed as action opportunities expire. We introduce Maturing Markov Decision Processes (MMDPs), a structured subclass of augmented finite-horizon Markov decision processes, for organizing when to commit and when to defer. The Expiring-Actions-First Principle provides a sufficient condition for deferral based on information gain and delay loss. When this condition cannot be certified, model bounds guide which persistent actions remain eligible. This structure motivates stage-local policies, action abstraction, and policy-guided planning. Replenishment experiments show improved learning and test performance under the MMDP interface and, in the primary setting, a larger test-performance gain from forecast refinement. translated_title: 何时承诺，何时推迟：信息精化与机会到期下的成熟马尔可夫决策过程
translated_abstract: 序贯决策往往随着行动机会的到期而获得更充分的信息。我们提出成熟马尔可夫决策过程（MMDPs），这是增广有限时域马尔可夫决策过程的一个结构化子类，用于组织何时承诺、何时推迟。到期行动优先原则基于信息增益与延迟损失，为推迟决策提供了充分条件。当该条件无法被认证时，模型边界会指导哪些持续存在的动作仍然具有资格。这一结构催生了阶段局部策略、动作抽象以及策略引导的规划。补货实验表明，在MMDP接口下学习与测试性能均有所改善，并且在主要场景中，预测精化带来了更大的测试性能提升。当推迟需要付出代价时，MMDP相对于固定推迟策略的优势开始出现的时机与理论分析一致，说明了扩展的到期行动优先原则……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出成熟马尔可夫决策过程（MMDP）及到期行动优先原则，基于信息增益与延迟损失为序贯决策中“何时承诺、何时推迟”提供结构化判据，并通过补货实验验证了学习与测试性能的提升。
en_tdlr: Introduces Maturing Markov Decision Processes (MMDPs) and the Expiring-Actions-First Principle, a structured criterion based on information gain versus delay loss for deciding when to commit or defer in sequential decisions, validated with improved learning and test performance in replenishment experiments.
